A '''battle droid [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]''' was a [[unit]] of the [[Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The battalion consisted [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], it was commanded by [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-55/Legends|TJ-55]].
